description: Adds user created organizer tabs to the AE2 terminals for easy filtering

mods.name: Storage Organizer
mods.description: Adds user-defined filter tabs to Applied Energistics 2 terminals and Refined Storage 2 grids. Create tabs that filter storage by mod, item tag, name, or data-component (NBT) criteria, then switch between them with one click. Each storage system keeps its own independent tabs. Fully client-side; both AE2 and Refined Storage are optional.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- **Minecraft 1.20.1:** AE2 terminals now open correctly. (1.21.1 and 26.1 were not affected.)
- **Dark mode:** button labels are readable again with AE2 dark-mode packs, and switching a pack on mid-session re-themes straight away.
- **GUI scale:** filter windows stay where you put them when the GUI scale changes.
- **JEI sync:** fixed a crash with filters longer than 128 characters. Long filters are now shortened to fit JEI's search box.

### Added

- A warning in the tab editor when a filter is too long to sync with JEI.

Fully client-side; both AE2 and Refined Storage are optional.

releases.notes:
## Drag & drop

Build filters by dragging items straight onto your filter windows.

- **Drop an item on a tab** - a prompt asks whether to add it **by name** or **by mod**, and adds that condition to the tab.
- **Drop it on the new `+` cell** at the end of the bar - opens the editor with a new tab already filled in: named and iconed after the item, and set up to match just that item. Adjust it and save.
- **Drag from anywhere** - an item on your cursor (from the terminal or your inventory), or straight out of JEI's item list. The item always goes back to your inventory afterwards, so nothing gets dropped on the floor.
- **Right-click a tab** to open the editor on that tab directly.

Works the same on Applied Energistics 2 terminals and Refined Storage grids. Still fully client-side, and your existing tabs and settings carry over untouched.
